title: Diagnostic accuracy of deep-learning models for COVID-19 detection from chest radiographs

pico.population: Chest radiograph (CXR) datasets from patients evaluated for COVID-19
pico.intervention: A deep-learning prediction model classifying CXR images for COVID-19
pico.comparator: A baseline model or radiologist reader
pico.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy (e.g. AUC, sensitivity/specificity) on a held-out test set
